title: Expression of Interest: Implementation of the Stress Testing System for CRDB Bank Plc
description: CRDB Bank intends to implement an automated Group-wide Stress Testing Solution to strengthen enterprise-wide risk oversight, support capital and liquidity planning, improve scenario analysis, and enhance resilience under adverse macroeconomic and idiosyncratic conditions across the Bank and its subsidiaries.
eligibility: Open for international competitive bidding. Vendors with proven experience implementing stress testing solutions for financial institutions.
